signals.title: Dr Pixley kaSeme Street, Durban CBD (approx.): immigrant man beaten to death by about 50 people in anti-immigrant march, 22 Oct
signals.content: Police say an immigrant man was beaten to death by a group of about 50 people on Dr Pixley kaSeme Street in the Durban CBD on the morning of Thursday 22 October. According to KwaZulu-Natal police spokesperson Col Robert Netshiunda, the group was marching on Dr Pixley kaSeme Street towards Maud Mfusi Street when two men split off and approached the man; about 50 people then assaulted him and he died. A murder case has been opened. A security guard in the area told GroundUp the group was out targeting immigrants and that the man was probably walking to work at around 7am. It happened during renewed anti-immigrant protests in Durban (GroundUp). On 23 October police said five men, aged 19 to 46, had been taken in for questioning in connection with this murder and other attacks on foreign nationals that week; police did not say whether they had been charged (IOL). The victim is not named here; police had not named him. Sources: GroundUp, 22 October; IOL, 23 October. The map point is approximate: the street is known, not the exact spot.

signals.title: Sbumbu Road, Amaoti, Inanda (map point estimated): two men shot dead, one wounded by two gunmen; murder cases, suspects sought, 25 Oct
signals.content: Police say three men were walking on Sbumbu Road in Amaoti, Inanda, north of Durban, on the morning of Sunday 25 October when two men emerged and fired at them. Two of the three died and the third was taken to a clinic. KwaZulu-Natal police spokesperson Paul Magwaza said police are investigating two cases of murder and one of attempted murder (via East Coast Radio). Reaction Unit South Africa, a private response unit, said the shooting followed a robbery that morning: one of the victims had reportedly gone back with two friends to confront the robbery suspects, who allegedly opened fire. A manhunt was under way; no arrest has been reported. The victims are not named here. One public report: East Coast Radio, 26 October. The map point is estimated: Sbumbu Road could not be found on a map, so the pin is a point in Amaoti, not the road.

signals.title: Strandbrook, Brookdale, Phoenix (approx.): man stabbed to death by three men on his way to a tuck shop; security-company account, 28 Oct
signals.content: A man was stabbed to death along Strandbrook in Brookdale, Phoenix, on the afternoon of Wednesday 28 October. According to KZN VIP Security, he was on his way to a local tuck shop when he got into a confrontation with three men, who allegedly assaulted him with various weapons and stabbed him several times; he was declared dead at the scene. KZN VIP Security, SAPS and other emergency services responded. KZN VIP spokesperson Gareth Naidoo said the circumstances, the motive and the identities of those involved had not been confirmed. This account comes from a private security company: no police statement was found, and SAPS has not confirmed a case. No arrest has been reported. The victim is not named here. Sources: Phoenix Tabloid, 29 October; Accidents.co.za, 29 October (the security company's statement). The map point is approximate: the pin is Strandbrook Crescent in Brookdale, the only Strandbrook found on the map there.
